newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy car offer to have little impact on CPI - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italy car offer to have little impact on CPI - Istat.

text.p: Italian statistics office Istat said that a government incentive plan to boost domestic car sales would have a limited impact on inflation data.
The government plan introduced this month gives motorists cash bonuses to scrap cars over 10 years old and buy new models.
Istat said in a statement that for its January inflation data it would estimate that the offer would affect just 7.4 percent of the Italian car market.

Car prices weigh some three percent in the overall inflation basket, meaning that the sector of the market affected by the government offer would weigh just over 0.2 percent in the whole inflation basket.
Analysts polled by Reuters predicted last week that inflation in January would remain steady at around 2.6 percent year-on-year, with a slight increase forecast on a monthly basis.
